comment: wb-a9l2.1 (the hk9l/5jha/zq7i roster pattern): the OUT-OF-FILE anchor for test/workbench-rf-federation-parity-premise.test.ts. rows: every judged row of ROWS in census order (FALSIFIERS 91, CONTROLS 32, RESIDUALS 15; wb-wfpj added F48-F51, N13-N15 and R11-R13 at its cut 1, F52-F68 and N16-N22 at its cut 2, which also widened R8 and R13, F69-F75, N23-N26, R14 and R15 at its cut 3, which also narrowed row titles to the forms their rows pin, and F76-F85, N27 and N28 at its cut 4; wb-mpuo added F86-F88 at its cut 1, and F89, F90 and N29-N31 at its cut 2, which also widened R8 and N26 and narrowed six row titles to the forms their rows pin, and F91 and N32 at its cut 3, which also widened R8 and F79 to every file shape the words name) - table, id, the registered test name, every finding the row reads and the sha256 of its input (files, bead lines, fixture state and receipts as JSON), written from the rows as measured at the cut. residuals: the header's named residual families, one pinned quiet row each. The census judges its in-file rows and its registered tests (vitest's task tree) against this file at test time, in order and both ways.
